definitions.short: to agree (on a time and place)
definitions.full: H2164. zeman [ זְמַן ] verb denominative Hithpa`el agree together ( ᵑ7 ); — Perfect 3masculine plural Dan 2:9 Qr הִזְדַּמִּנְתּוּן (D 211, 2nd ed. 263 M § 12 a ; Kt Haph`el הַזְמִנְתּוּן , see ᵑ7 Onk Exod 5:14 D (2) 263, 403), followed by Infinitive לְמֵאמַר .
